items.title: Don Albert Interview, 1973-08-06
items.q: I took Ben O' Kennedy quit his band, I took Ben O' Kennedy's place.

ctx.x: Why did you go on that train? You went to Wichita? No, no.

That was during the days of the, what do you call it, the Dixie Series. We used to have Texas and Louisiana, we played at the winners from each, and we were going to Dallas. That's where you first went? That's where we stopped. Those guys had me playing my horn all night on the train, Herschel and a few of the others. And that's when we got off to Dallas. That's where Herschel separated from me, went on with the T&T band. And I had Lucien and McCarthy, Richard. And we played at one of the roughest joints in…
Now what kind of band was that that you were there, with McCarthy and Jeff?
